game.name: Pioneers
game.desc: A free, faithful clone of the Settlers of Catan board game. Trade, build, and race to 10 victory points against up to 3 AI opponents, on any of dozens of official and community map layouts. This port auto-detects the device's screen shape and lays out the board, resource panel, and chat log to actually fit it.
game.developer: Dave Cole and the Pioneers team
